video_prompt: One continuous vertical phone selfie video, full frame edge to edge from the first frame to the last. The woman, a young Black woman around 23 years old with long waist-length black box braids pulled over one shoulder, deep brown skin, dark eyes, small gold hoop earrings, wearing a burgundy ribbed knit top, sits alone in a living room full of plants: a sage green wall, a large monstera, hanging plants in macrame holders, a mid-brown leather armchair behind her and a wooden side table, and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same seat, same distance from the camera. The phone rests on a tripod and the camera stays still; the room around her stays still. She talks straight into the camera, sincere and a little emotional, like telling a friend a personal story, with small natural head movements and expressive hand gestures in front of her chest.
